translations.idiomatic: (younger nephews: Jing, Zong; Jing's sons: Zonghui, Zongliang)

sentences.zh: 張敦禮任澤

translations.literal: Zhang Dunli, Ren Ze
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Dunli and Ren Ze

sentences.zh: 王貽永字季長，溥之孫也。

translations.literal: Wang Yiyong, courtesy name Jichang, was a grandson of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yiyong, whose courtesy name was Jichang, was a grandson of Pu.

sentences.zh: 性清慎寡言，頗通書，不好聲技。

translations.literal: By nature he was pure, cautious, and sparing of speech; he was well versed in books and did not care for music and skilled performances.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was pure, cautious, and sparing of speech; he was well versed in the classics and had no taste for music or the performing arts.

sentences.zh: 初生十餘歲時，其舅魏咸信見而奇之，曰：「後當類我。」

translations.literal: When he was first born, in his early teens, his maternal uncle Wei Xianxin saw him and marveled, saying: "He will in time resemble me."
translations.idiomatic: When he was still in his early teens, his maternal uncle Wei Xianxin saw him and was struck by his promise, saying, "In time he will be like me."

sentences.zh: 咸平中，尚鄭國公主，授右衛將軍、駙馬都尉。

translations.literal: During the Xianping era, he married the Princess of Zheng and was appointed Right Guards General and Commandant of the Horse for the Son-in-Law.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianping era he married the Princess of Zheng and was appointed Right Guards General and Commandant of the Horse for the Imperial Son-in-Law.

sentences.zh: 從封泰山，領高州刺史，再遷右監門衛大將軍、獎州團練使。

translations.literal: He accompanied the emperor to perform the feng sacrifice at Mount Tai, was put in charge of Gaozhou, and was later transferred to Grand General of the Right Jianmen Guard and Military Training Commissioner of Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He accompanied the emperor to Mount Tai for the feng sacrifice, was put in charge of Gaozhou, and was later transferred to Grand General of the Right Jianmen Guard and Military Training Commissioner of Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 求外補，得知單州。

translations.literal: He requested an outside appointment and was made prefect of Shan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He requested an outside appointment and was made prefect of Shan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 真宗戒之曰：「和眾靜治，卿所 當先也。」

translations.literal: Emperor Zhenzong admonished him, saying: "Harmonizing the people and governing with calm—this is what you should put first.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhenzong admonished him, saying, "Harmonizing the people and governing with calm—this is what you must put first.

sentences.zh: 真拜洺州團練使、徙徐州。

translations.literal: He was then formally appointed Military Training Commissioner of Ming Prefecture and transferred to Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was then formally appointed Military Training Commissioner of Ming Prefecture and transferred to Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 河決滑州，徐大水，貽永作堤城南以禦之。

translations.literal: When the Yellow River broke through at Huazhou and Xuzhou suffered great flooding, Yiyong built dikes south of the city to hold it back.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yellow River broke through at Huazhou and Xuzhou was inundated, Yiyong built dikes south of the city to hold back the waters.

sentences.zh: 改衛州團練使，進懷州防禦使，知澶、定二州，徙成德軍。

translations.literal: He was changed to Military Training Commissioner of Wei Prefecture, promoted to Defender of Huai Prefecture, made prefect of Chan and Ding prefectures, and transferred to Chengde Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was changed to Military Training Commissioner of Wei Prefecture, promoted to Defender of Huai Prefecture, made prefect of Chan and Ding prefectures, and transferred to Chengde Army.

sentences.zh: 會有告曹 訥變者，貽永奏治之。

translations.literal: When someone reported that Cao Ne was plotting rebellion, Yiyong memorialized to investigate and punish it.
translations.idiomatic: When someone reported that Cao Ne was plotting rebellion, Yiyong memorialized to have the matter investigated and punished.

sentences.zh: 遷耀州觀察使，復知澶州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Observer of Yaozhou and again made prefect of Chan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Observer of Yaozhou and again made prefect of Chan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 曆彰化、武定軍節度使觀察留後，拜安德軍節度使。

translations.literal: He successively served as Military Governor and Observer-in-Residence of Zhanghua and Wuding armies, then was appointed Military Governor of Ande Army.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as Military Governor and Observer-in-Residence of the Zhanghua and Wuding armies, then was appointed Military Governor of Ande Army.

sentences.zh: 出知天雄軍，徙保寧軍節度使、知鄆州。

translations.literal: He went out to govern Tianxiong Army, then was transferred to Military Governor of Baoning Army and prefect of Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He went out to govern Tianxiong Army, then was transferred to Military Governor of Baoning Army and prefect of Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 州自咸平中徙城，而 故治為通衢，介梁山，春夏多水患，貽永相度地勢，為築東西道三十餘里，民便之。

translations.literal: Since the prefecture had moved its city in the Xianping era, the old seat had become a main thoroughfare bordered by Liang Mountain; in spring and summer there were many water disasters. Yiyong surveyed the terrain and built east-west roads more than thirty li long, to the people's convenience.
translations.idiomatic: Since the prefecture had moved its seat in the Xianping era, the old site had become a main thoroughfare hemmed in by Liang Mountain; in spring and summer flooding was frequent. Yiyong surveyed the terrain and built east-west roads more than thirty li long, greatly to the people's benefit.

sentences.zh: 復徙定州，又徙成德軍。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Ding Prefecture, then again to Chengde Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred to Ding Prefecture, then again to Chengde Army.

sentences.zh: 擢同知樞密院事，改副使，加宣徽南院使，進樞密院 使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, then changed to Vice Director, added as Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Privy Pavilion, and advanced to Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, then changed to Vice Director, added as Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Privy Pavilion, and advanced to Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 久之，拜同中書門下平章事，遂加兼侍中。

translations.literal: After some time he was appointed Vice Grand Councillor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and then additionally given the concurrent title of Palace Minister.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he was appointed Vice Grand Councillor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and then additionally given the concurrent title of Palace Minister.

sentences.zh: 徙節鎮海，以疾求罷，手詔撫諭，遣上醫診視。

translations.literal: He was transferred to govern Zhenhai. Because of illness he asked to be relieved; the emperor wrote him personally to comfort and reassure him, and sent a senior physician to examine him.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to govern Zhenhai. Citing illness, he asked to be relieved; the emperor wrote him a personal edict of comfort and reassurance and sent a senior physician to examine him.

sentences.zh: 帝臨問，頒尚方珍藥，手取糜粥食之。

translations.literal: The emperor visited to inquire after him, distributed precious medicines from the imperial pharmacy, and personally took congee and fed it to him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor visited him in person, distributed precious medicines from the imperial pharmacy, and personally took congee and fed it to him.

sentences.zh: 貽永自言寵祿過 盛，願罷樞筦，解使相還第。

translations.literal: Yiyong himself said his honors and emoluments were excessive, and asked to be relieved of his duties at the Bureau of Military Affairs and to resign his commissioner's and chancellor's posts and return home.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyong himself said that his honors and emoluments were excessive, and asked to be relieved of his duties at the Bureau of Military Affairs and to resign his posts as commissioner and chancellor and return home.

sentences.zh: 帝冀其愈也，乃聽罷侍中，徙彰德節度使，同平章事、樞密使如故。

translations.literal: The emperor hoped he would recover, so he allowed him to relinquish the post of Palace Minister, transferred him to Military Governor of Zhangde, and kept his posts as Vice Grand Councillor and Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor hoped he would recover, so he allowed him to relinquish the post of Palace Minister, transferred him to Military Governor of Zhangde, and kept his posts as Vice Grand Councillor and Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs unchanged.

sentences.zh: 疾稍間，入見，命其子道卿掖登垂拱殿。

translations.literal: When his illness eased somewhat, he entered audience; the emperor ordered his son Daoqing to support him up into the Hall of Repose and Dignity.
translations.idiomatic: When his illness eased somewhat, he came to audience; the emperor ordered his son Daoqing to support him up into the Hall of Repose and Dignity.

sentences.zh: 仍賜五日一朝，遇朝參起 居，許休於殿側。

translations.literal: He was also granted attendance at court once every five days; when he attended morning audience and levee, he was permitted to rest at the side of the hall.
translations.idiomatic: He was also granted attendance at court once every five days; when he attended morning audience and the daily levee, he was permitted to rest at the side of the hall.

sentences.zh: 至和初，復以疾辭，拜尚書右僕射、檢校太師兼侍中、景靈宮使。

translations.literal: Early in the Zhihe era, he again resigned citing illness and was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Preceptor in Acting Capacity and Concurrent Palace Minister, and Commissioner of the Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhihe era, he again resigned citing illness and was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Preceptor in Acting Capacity and Concurrent Palace Minister, and Commissioner of the Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈太師、中書令，諡康靖。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat; his posthumous title was Kangjing.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat; his posthumous title was Kangjing.

sentences.zh: 當時無外姻輔政者，貽永能遠權勢，在樞密十五年，迄無過失，人稱其謙靜。

translations.literal: At the time there was no maternal relative of the imperial family assisting in government. Yiyong was able to keep away from power; he served at the Bureau of Military Affairs for fifteen years without a single fault, and people praised his modesty and calm.
translations.idiomatic: At the time no maternal relative of the imperial family was assisting in government. Yiyong was able to keep his distance from power; he served at the Bureau of Military Affairs for fifteen years without a single fault, and people praised his modesty and calm.

sentences.zh: 子道卿，西上閣門使。

translations.literal: His son Daoqing was Commissioner of the Western Upper Gate.
translations.idiomatic: His son Daoqing was Commissioner of the Western Upper Gate.

sentences.zh: 李昭亮，字晦之，明德太后兄繼隆子也。

translations.literal: Li Zhaoliang, courtesy name Huizhi, was a son of Li Jilong, elder brother of Empress Dowager Mingde.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhaoliang, whose courtesy name was Huizhi, was a son of Li Jilong, elder brother of Empress Dowager Mingde.

sentences.zh: 四歲，補東頭供奉官，許出入禁中。

translations.literal: At age four he was appointed Eastern Head Palace Attendant and permitted to enter and leave the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: At age four he was appointed Eastern Head Palace Attendant and permitted to enter and leave the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 繼隆北征契丹，遣昭亮持詔軍中。

translations.literal: When Jilong campaigned north against the Khitan, he sent Zhaoliang to bear the edict to the army.
translations.idiomatic: When Jilong campaigned north against the Khitan, he sent Zhaoliang to bear the edict to the army.

sentences.zh: 問方略及營陣眾寡之勢，昭亮年雖少，還奏稱旨。

translations.literal: He was questioned on strategy and the strength and deployment of the camps; though young, Zhaoliang returned and reported to the emperor's satisfaction.
translations.idiomatic: He was questioned on strategy and the strength and disposition of the camps; though still young, Zhaoliang returned and reported to the emperor's satisfaction.

sentences.zh: 累遷西上閣門使。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Commissioner of the Western Upper Gate.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Commissioner of the Western Upper Gate.

sentences.zh: 出為潞州兵馬鈐轄，徙領麟府路軍馬事，尋為管勾軍頭引見司兼三司衙司。

translations.literal: He went out as Military Commandant of Luzhou and was transferred to oversee the military affairs of the Lin-Fu Circuit; soon he became Manager of the Army Head Presentation Office and concurrent Manager of the Three Commissions Office.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as Military Commandant of Luzhou and was transferred to oversee the military affairs of the Lin-Fu Circuit; soon he became Manager of the Army Head Presentation Office and concurrent Manager of the Three Commissions Office.

sentences.zh: 軍士有逃死而冒請官廩者數百人，昭亮按發之。

translations.literal: Several hundred soldiers who had deserted or died had fraudulently drawn government rations; Zhaoliang investigated and exposed them.
translations.idiomatic: Several hundred soldiers who had deserted or died had fraudulently drawn government rations; Zhaoliang investigated and exposed them.

sentences.zh: 領高州刺史，知代州。

translations.literal: He was put in charge of Gaozhou and made prefect of Dai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was put in charge of Gaozhou and made prefect of Dai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以四方館使復領麟府路軍馬事。

translations.literal: As Commissioner of the Four Directions Hall he again supervised military affairs on the Lin-Fu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: As Commissioner of the Four Directions Hall he again supervised military affairs on the Lin-Fu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 遷引進使，領賀州團練使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Introducing Commissioner and put in charge as Military Training Commissioner of He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Introducing Commissioner and put in charge as Military Training Commissioner of He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 曆知瀛定二州、成州團練使、寧州防禦使、延州觀察使、感德軍節度觀察留後。

translations.literal: He successively served as prefect of Ying and Ding prefectures, Military Training Commissioner of Cheng Prefecture, Defender of Ning Prefecture, Observer of Yan Prefecture, and Military Governor and Observer-in-Residence of Gande Army.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as prefect of Ying and Ding prefectures, Military Training Commissioner of Cheng Prefecture, Defender of Ning Prefecture, Observer of Yan Prefecture, and Military Governor and Observer-in-Residence of Gande Army.

sentences.zh: 擢殿前都虞候、秦鳳路馬 步軍副都總管、經略招討副使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Chief Military Inspector of the Palace Front, Deputy Overall Commander of the Cavalry-and-Infantry of the Qinfeng Circuit, and Vice Commissioner for Military Affairs and Pacification.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Chief Military Inspector of the Palace Front, Deputy Overall Commander of the Cavalry-and-Infantry of the Qinfeng Circuit, and Vice Commissioner for Military Affairs and Pacification.

sentences.zh: 徙永興路馬步軍副都指揮使、並代州路副都總管、安撫招討副使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Deputy Overall Commander of the Cavalry-and-Infantry of the Yongxing Circuit, Deputy Overall Commander of the Bing-Dai Circuit, and Vice Commissioner for Pacification and Pacification.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Deputy Overall Commander of the Cavalry-and-Infantry of the Yongxing Circuit, Deputy Overall Commander of the Bing-Dai Circuit, and Vice Commissioner for Pacification and Pacification.

sentences.zh: 未幾，守代州，再徙真定路都總管。

translations.literal: Before long he defended Dai Prefecture, then was again transferred to Overall Commander of the Zhending Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he defended Dai Prefecture, then was again transferred to Overall Commander of the Zhending Circuit.

sentences.zh: 保州兵叛，殺官 吏，詔遣王果招降之，叛者乘埤呼曰：「得李步軍來，我降矣。」

translations.literal: Soldiers at Baozhou rebelled and killed officials. An edict ordered Wang Guo to summon them to surrender. The rebels stood on the battlements and shouted: "If we can get Lord Li the infantry commander to come, we will surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers at Baozhou rebelled and killed officials. An edict ordered Wang Guo to summon them to surrender. The rebels stood on the battlements and shouted, "If Lord Li the infantry commander will come, we will surrender.

sentences.zh: 於是遣昭亮，昭亮從輕騎數十人，不持甲盾弓矢，叩城門呼城上曰：「爾輩第來降，我保其無虞 也。

translations.literal: So Zhaoliang was dispatched. Zhaoliang took several dozen light horsemen, carried no armor, shields, bows, or arrows, knocked at the city gate, and called up to the wall: "You need only come down and surrender; I guarantee your safety.
translations.idiomatic: So Zhaoliang was dispatched. He took several dozen light horsemen, carried no armor, shields, bows, or arrows, knocked at the city gate, and called up to the wall, "You need only come down and surrender; I guarantee your safety.

sentences.zh: 不爾，幾無噍類矣。」

translations.literal: Otherwise there will scarcely be a mouth left among you.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise there will scarcely be a mouth left among you.

sentences.zh: 卒稍稍縋城下。

translations.literal: Gradually the soldiers were lowered from the wall on ropes.
translations.idiomatic: Gradually the soldiers were lowered from the wall on ropes.

sentences.zh: 明日，相率開城門降。

translations.literal: The next day they opened the city gates in succession and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The next day they opened the city gates in succession and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 改淮康軍節度觀察留後，復知定州，敕使存勞，賜黃金三百兩，給節度使奉，以褒其功。

translations.literal: He was changed to Military Governor and Observer-in-Residence of the Huaikang Army, again made prefect of Ding Prefecture. An imperial envoy was sent to comfort him; he was granted three hundred taels of gold and given a military governor's salary, in recognition of his merit.
translations.idiomatic: He was changed to Military Governor and Observer-in-Residence of the Huaikang Army and again made prefect of Ding Prefecture. An imperial envoy was sent to comfort him; he was granted three hundred taels of gold and given a military governor's salary, in recognition of his merit.

sentences.zh: 都轉運使 歐陽修言：「昭亮入保州，以叛卒女口分隸諸軍，有輒私入其家者。」

translations.literal: Director of Transport Ouyang Xiu said: "When Zhaoliang entered Baozhou, he distributed the rebel soldiers' women among the various armies, and some entered their homes privately.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Transport Ouyang Xiu said, "When Zhaoliang entered Baozhou, he distributed the rebel soldiers' women among the various armies, and some men entered their homes privately.

sentences.zh: 置不問。

translations.literal: This was set aside without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: This was set aside without inquiry.

sentences.zh: 明年，拜武寧軍節度使，代李用和為殿前副都指揮使。

translations.literal: The next year he was appointed Military Governor of the Wuning Army, replacing Li Yonghe as Deputy Overall Commander of the Palace Front.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was appointed Military Governor of the Wuning Army, replacing Li Yonghe as Deputy Overall Commander of the Palace Front.

sentences.zh: 時承平久，將士 多因循樂縱弛。

translations.literal: The realm had been at peace for a long time, and officers and soldiers for the most part had grown slack and lax.
translations.idiomatic: The realm had been at peace for a long time, and officers and soldiers for the most part had grown slack and lax.

sentences.zh: 昭亮本將家子，雖以恩澤進，然習軍中事，既統宿衛，政尚嚴，多所建請。

translations.literal: Zhaoliang was originally from a military family; though he advanced through imperial favor, he was versed in military affairs. Once he commanded the palace guard, his administration was strict and he made many proposals.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoliang was originally from a military family; though he advanced through imperial favor, he was versed in military affairs. Once he commanded the palace guard, his administration was strict and he made many proposals.

sentences.zh: 萬勝、龍猛軍蒲博爭勝負，徹屋椽相擊，士皆惶駭，昭亮捕斬之，杖其主 者，諸軍為之股慄。

translations.literal: Soldiers of the Wansheng and Longmeng armies gambled at dice and quarreled over wins and losses, tore off roof rafters and struck one another; the troops were all terrified. Zhaoliang seized and executed them, flogged their ringleaders, and the armies trembled in fear.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers of the Wansheng and Longmeng armies gambled at dice and quarreled over wins and losses, tore off roof rafters and struck one another; the troops were all terrified. Zhaoliang seized and executed them, flogged their ringleaders, and the armies trembled in fear.

sentences.zh: 帝祠南郊，有騎卒亡所挾弓，會赦，當釋去，昭亮曰：「宿衛不謹，不可貸。」

translations.literal: When the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburb, a cavalry soldier lost the bow he carried. An amnesty was in effect and he should have been released, but Zhaoliang said: "Palace guard duty was performed carelessly; this cannot be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburb, a cavalry soldier lost the bow he carried. An amnesty was in effect and he should have been released, but Zhaoliang said, "Palace guard duty was performed carelessly; this cannot be pardoned.

sentences.zh: 卒配隸下軍，禁兵自是頓肅。

translations.literal: The soldier was reassigned to an inferior army; from then on the palace guard was abruptly disciplined.
translations.idiomatic: The soldier was reassigned to an inferior army; from then on the palace guard was abruptly disciplined.

sentences.zh: 以宣徽北院使判河 陽，徙延州。

translations.literal: He was made Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Privy Pavilion with authority over Heyang, and transferred to Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Privy Pavilion with authority over Heyang, and transferred to Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以南院使判澶州，徙并州、成德軍，拜同中書門下平章事，判大名府。

translations.literal: As Commissioner of the Southern Bureau he was given authority over Chan Prefecture, transferred to Bing Prefecture and Chengde Army, appointed Vice Grand Councillor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and given authority over Daming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: As Commissioner of the Southern Bureau he was given authority over Chan Prefecture, transferred to Bing Prefecture and Chengde Army, appointed Vice Grand Councillor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and given authority over Daming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 仁宗以塗金紋羅書曰：「李昭亮親賢勳舊。」

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong wrote on gilded patterned silk: "Li Zhaoliang is a close worthy and an old merit-holder.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong wrote on gilded patterned silk, "Li Zhaoliang is a close worthy and an old merit-holder.

sentences.zh: 命其子惟賢持以賜。

translations.literal: He ordered his son Weixian to carry and present it as a gift.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered his son Weixian to carry and present it as a gift.

sentences.zh: 徙定州，改天 平、彰信、泰寧軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Ding Prefecture and changed to Military Governor of Tianping, Zhangxin, and Taining armies.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Ding Prefecture and changed to Military Governor of the Tianping, Zhangxin, and Taining armies.

sentences.zh: 在定州數言老疾不任邊事，願還京師，乃以為景靈宮使，又改昭德軍節度使。

translations.literal: At Ding Prefecture he repeatedly said that old age and illness left him unfit for frontier duties and that he wished to return to the capital; he was then made Commissioner of the Jingling Palace, and again changed to Military Governor of the Zhaode Army.
translations.idiomatic: At Ding Prefecture he repeatedly said that old age and illness left him unfit for frontier duties and that he wished to return to the capital; he was then made Commissioner of the Jingling Palace, and again changed to Military Governor of the Zhaode Army.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈中書令，諡良僖。

translations.literal: He died; he was posthumously granted Director of the Secretariat and given the posthumous title Liangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He died; he was posthumously granted Director of the Secretariat and given the posthumous title Liangxi.

sentences.zh: 昭亮為人和易，練習近事，於吏治頗通敏，善委任僚佐，以故數更藩鎮無他過。

translations.literal: Zhaoliang was easy and affable by nature, practiced in recent affairs, quite adept in administrative governance, and good at delegating to subordinates; for this reason, though he changed posts among many frontier commands, he had no other faults.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoliang was easy and affable by nature, practiced in recent affairs, quite adept in administrative governance, and good at delegating to subordinates; for this reason, though he changed posts among many frontier commands, he had no other faults.

sentences.zh: 昭亮妻早亡，內嬖三妾迭預家政，莫能製也。

translations.literal: Zhaoliang's wife died early; three favored concubines within the household successively took part in domestic affairs, and he could not control them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoliang's wife died early; three favored concubines within the household successively took part in domestic affairs, and he could not control them.

sentences.zh: 子惟賢，字寶臣，以父蔭為三班奉職，後為閣門祗候、通事舍人。

translations.literal: His son Weixian, courtesy name Baochen, entered office through his father's privilege as Third-Rank Attendant, later serving as Gate Attendant and Herald.
translations.idiomatic: His son Weixian, whose courtesy name was Baochen, entered office through his father's privilege as Third-Rank Attendant, later serving as Gate Attendant and Herald.

sentences.zh: 累遷西上閣門使，尋領高州刺史、知莫州，州倉粟陳腐，戍兵大噪，弗肯受，州人皆恐，惟賢馳 往諭曰：「邊兵眾則積粟多，廩數多且積久，能無陳腐乎？

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Commissioner of the Western Upper Gate; soon he was put in charge of Gaozhou and made prefect of Mo Prefecture. The prefectural granary grain was moldy; the garrison soldiers made a great clamor and refused to accept it; the people of the prefecture were all afraid. Weixian galloped there and explained: "Where border troops are numerous, grain is stockpiled in quantity; the stores are many and have accumulated for long—how can there be no mold?
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Commissioner of the Western Upper Gate; soon he was put in charge of Gaozhou and made prefect of Mo Prefecture. The prefectural granary grain was moldy; the garrison soldiers made a great clamor and refused to accept it; the people of the prefecture were all afraid. Weixian galloped there and explained, "Where border troops are numerous, grain is stockpiled in quantity; the stores are many and have accumulated for long—how can there be no mold?

sentences.zh: 欲盡取新，則陳者何所歸？」

translations.literal: If you insist on taking only new grain, where is the old grain to go?
translations.idiomatic: If you insist on taking only new grain, where is the old grain to go?

sentences.zh: 遂斬首惡一人，流十人，軍中帖然。

translations.literal: He then beheaded one ringleader and exiled ten men; the army quieted down.
translations.idiomatic: He then beheaded one ringleader and exiled ten men; the army quieted down.

sentences.zh: 召還，提舉諸司庫務，領榮州團練使、 知冀州。

translations.literal: He was recalled, appointed to oversee the warehouses of various offices, put in charge as Military Training Commissioner of Rong Prefecture, and made prefect of Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled, appointed to oversee the warehouses of various offices, put in charge as Military Training Commissioner of Rong Prefecture, and made prefect of Ji Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 會遷補禁軍，自隸籍後犯贓汙者皆絀為下軍，惟賢曰：「武士何可責以廉節？

translations.literal: When the palace guard was reorganized and replenished, all who had been registered and later committed corruption were demoted to inferior armies. Weixian said: "How can one demand integrity from soldiers?
translations.idiomatic: When the palace guard was reorganized and replenished, all who had been registered and later committed corruption were demoted to inferior armies. Weixian said, "How can one demand integrity from soldiers?

sentences.zh: 且抵罪在昔，今不可以新令繩之。」

translations.literal: Besides, their offenses were in the past; they cannot now be bound by the new regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Besides, their offenses were in the past; they cannot now be bound by the new regulation.

sentences.zh: 帝為更其制，徙恩州，後遷四方館使， 卒。

translations.literal: The emperor altered the regulation for him; he was transferred to En Prefecture, later promoted to Commissioner of the Four Directions Hall, and died.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor altered the regulation for him; he was transferred to En Prefecture, later promoted to Commissioner of the Four Directions Hall, and died.

sentences.zh: 惟賢善宣辭令，習朝儀，仁宗頗愛之。

translations.literal: Weixian was skilled at proclaiming edicts and versed in court ceremony; Emperor Renzong was quite fond of him.
translations.idiomatic: Weixian was skilled at proclaiming edicts and versed in court ceremony; Emperor Renzong was quite fond of him.

sentences.zh: 李用和，字審禮，章懿皇太后弟也。

translations.literal: Li Yonghe, courtesy name Shenli, was a younger brother of Empress Dowager Zhangyi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yonghe, whose courtesy name was Shenli, was a younger brother of Empress Dowager Zhangyi.

sentences.zh: 少窮困，居京師鑿紙錢為業，劉美求用和於民間，奏為三班奉職。

translations.literal: In youth he was poor and in distress; living in the capital he made a living carving spirit money. Liu Mei sought out Yonghe among the common people and memorialized to appoint him Third-Rank Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was poor and in distress; living in the capital he made a living carving spirit money. Liu Mei sought out Yonghe among the common people and memorialized to appoint him Third-Rank Attendant.

sentences.zh: 累遷右侍禁、閣門祗候、權提點在京倉草場、考城縣兵馬都監。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Right Palace Guard, Gate Attendant, Acting Intendant of the Capital Granary and Hay Storehouse, and Military Director of Kaocheng County.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Right Palace Guard, Gate Attendant, Acting Intendant of the Capital Granary and Hay Storehouse, and Military Director of Kaocheng County.

sentences.zh: 太后崩，詔赴喪。

translations.literal: When the empress dowager died, an edict ordered him to attend the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager died, an edict ordered him to attend the mourning.

sentences.zh: 既葬，遷禮賓副使，領八作司。

translations.literal: After the burial, he was transferred to Vice Commissioner of Ceremonial Reception and put in charge of the Eight Works Office.
translations.idiomatic: After the burial, he was transferred to Vice Commissioner of Ceremonial Reception and put in charge of the Eight Works Office.

sentences.zh: 遷禮賓使，同領皇城司。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Commissioner of Ceremonial Reception and concurrently put in charge of the Imperial City Office.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Commissioner of Ceremonial Reception and concurrently put in charge of the Imperial City Office.

sentences.zh: 遷崇儀使、賀州刺史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Commissioner of Honored Ceremonies and put in charge of He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Commissioner of Honored Ceremonies and put in charge of He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 改葬太后於永安，領捧日、天武兵護梓宮。

translations.literal: When the empress dowager was reburied at Yong'an, he led the Sun-Upholding and Celestial Martial troops to escort the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager was reburied at Yong'an, he led the Sun-Upholding and Celestial Martial troops to escort the coffin.

sentences.zh: 明年春，又詔乘傳行太后陵。

translations.literal: The next spring, an edict again ordered him to travel by post-horse to the empress dowager's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: The next spring, an edict again ordered him to travel by post-horse to the empress dowager's tomb.

sentences.zh: 還，授寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On his return, he was appointed Prefect of Ning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When he returned, he was appointed prefect of Ning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 曆遷澤州團練、慶州防禦、鄜州觀察使。

translations.literal: In succession he was transferred to be Regimental Commissioner of Ze Prefecture, Defense Commissioner of Qing Prefecture, and Observation Commissioner of Fu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in turn to regimental commissioner of Ze Prefecture, defense commissioner of Qing Prefecture, and observation commissioner of Fu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 既而擢殿前都虞候、鄜延路馬步軍副都總管。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was promoted to Chief Inspector of the Palace Front and Deputy Overall Commander of the Cavalry and Infantry of the Fuyan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to chief inspector of the Palace Front and deputy overall commander of the cavalry and infantry on the Fuyan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 未行，拜永清軍節度觀察留 後，改真定府、定州路。

translations.literal: Before he set out, he was appointed Military Governor and Observation Commissioner of Yongqing Army, with the title of Acting Governor, and his jurisdiction was changed to Zhending Prefecture and Ding Prefecture Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could take up the post, he was appointed military governor and observation commissioner of Yongqing Army as acting governor, with jurisdiction over Zhending Prefecture and the Dingzhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 舊制，刺史以上所賜公使錢得私入，而用和悉用為軍費。

translations.literal: By old regulation, the public-service funds granted to prefects and above could be taken for private use, but Yonghe used all of them for military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old rules, prefects and higher officials were allowed to keep the public-service funds allotted to them, but Yonghe spent all of his on military expenses.

sentences.zh: 曆侍衛親軍步軍馬軍副都指揮使，拜建武軍節度使、殿前副都指揮使。

translations.literal: He successively served as Deputy Commander of the Imperial Guard's Infantry and Cavalry, and was appointed Military Governor of Jianwu Army and Deputy Overall Commander of the Palace Front.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as deputy commander of the imperial guard's infantry and cavalry, and was appointed military governor of Jianwu Army and deputy overall commander of the Palace Front.

sentences.zh: 以老乞罷軍 職，拜宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: On account of old age he requested to be relieved of military duties and was appointed Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Citing his age, he asked to be relieved of military duties and was appointed commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 逾月，改彰信軍節度使、同中書門下平章事、景靈宮使。

translations.literal: After more than a month, he was transferred to Military Governor of Zhangxin Army, made Grand Councilor with concurrent appointment, and appointed Commissioner of the Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: A little over a month later, he was transferred to military governor of Zhangxin Army, made grand councilor, and appointed commissioner of the Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 以疾告，仁宗臨問，賜銀飾肩輿，進兼侍中。

translations.literal: He reported illness, and Emperor Renzong visited him in person to inquire after him, bestowed a silver-decorated sedan chair, and promoted him to also serve as Palace Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: When he reported that he was ill, Emperor Renzong visited him in person, gave him a silver-decorated sedan chair, and promoted him to also serve as palace secretary.

sentences.zh: 初，未有居第，詔寓館芳林園，用和固辭，又假以惠寧坊之官第。

translations.literal: At first, having no residence of his own, he was ordered to lodge in the Fanglin Garden guesthouse; Yonghe firmly declined, and was then lent an official residence in Huining Ward.
translations.idiomatic: At first he had no home of his own, and the court ordered him to stay in the guesthouse at Fanglin Garden. Yonghe firmly declined, and was instead lent an official residence in Huining Ward.

sentences.zh: 病革，帝入見臥內，擢其次子珣為閣門使，賜所居第，並日給官舍僦錢五千。

translations.literal: When his illness became critical, the emperor entered and saw him in his bedchamber, promoted his second son Xun to Gate Commissioner, granted him the residence in which he lived, and also gave five thousand in daily rental money for an official residence.
translations.idiomatic: When his illness turned critical, the emperor came to his bedside, promoted his second son Xun to gate commissioner, granted him the house he lived in, and also allotted him five thousand cash per day as rent for an official residence.

sentences.zh: 既卒，帝哭之慟，贈太師、中書令、隴西郡王，輟朝五日，製服禁中，諡恭僖，帝撰神道碑，書曰「親賢之碑」。

translations.literal: After he died, the emperor wept for him in deep grief, posthumously enfeoffed him as Grand Preceptor, Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Longxi Commandery, suspended court for five days, and wore mourning within the palace. His posthumous title was Gongxi. The emperor composed his spirit-way stele and inscribed it "Stele of the Beloved Kinsman."
translations.idiomatic: After his death, the emperor mourned him deeply, posthumously enfeoffing him as grand preceptor, director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Longxi Commandery. Court was suspended for five days, and the emperor wore mourning within the palace. He was given the posthumous title Gongxi. The emperor wrote his spirit-way stele and titled it "Stele of the Beloved Kinsman."

sentences.zh: 其妻卒，亦輟朝成服。

translations.literal: When his wife died, the emperor again suspended court and donned mourning garments.
translations.idiomatic: When his wife died as well, the emperor again suspended court and put on mourning.

sentences.zh: 初，仁宗以太后不逮養，故外家褒寵特厚。

translations.literal: At first, because the empress dowager had not been able to enjoy his care while alive, Emperor Renzong therefore bestowed especially lavish honors on her maternal family.
translations.idiomatic: Because the empress dowager had died before he could care for her in her old age, Emperor Renzong lavished especially great honors on her family.

sentences.zh: 用和列位將相，能小心靜默，推遠權勢，論者以此稱之。

translations.literal: Yonghe held rank among generals and chief ministers, yet was able to be cautious and reticent, keeping himself at a distance from power, and commentators praised him for this.
translations.idiomatic: Though Yonghe held rank among generals and chief ministers, he was cautious and reticent and kept his distance from power, and commentators praised him for it.

sentences.zh: 子璋。

translations.literal: His son was Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Zhang.

sentences.zh: 璋字公明，以章懿皇后恩，補三班借職，積官為天平軍節度觀察留後，知澶州。

translations.literal: Zhang, courtesy name Gongming, by the grace of Empress Zhangyi was appointed to a borrowed third-rank post, and through accumulated offices became Acting Military Governor and Observation Commissioner of Tianping Army and Prefect of Cao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang, courtesy name Gongming, received a borrowed third-rank appointment through the favor of Empress Zhangyi. Through successive promotions he became acting military governor and observation commissioner of Tianping Army and prefect of Cao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 護塞商胡，會河漲，訛言水且至，璋據廳事自若，人心乃安，河亦不溢。

translations.literal: While defending the Shanghu Pass, the river rose; false reports spread that the water was about to arrive. Zhang sat calmly in the hall of audience, the people's hearts were then settled, and the river did not overflow.
translations.idiomatic: While defending the Shanghu Pass, the river rose and rumors spread that floodwaters were imminent. Zhang remained calmly in the hall of audience, the people settled down, and the river did not overflow.

sentences.zh: 徙曹州觀 察使，累遷武勝軍節度使、殿前都指揮使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Observation Commissioner of Cao Prefecture, and through repeated promotions became Military Governor of Wusheng Army and Overall Commander of the Palace Front.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to observation commissioner of Cao Prefecture, and was eventually promoted to military governor of Wusheng Army and overall commander of the Palace Front.

sentences.zh: 仁宗書「忠孝李璋」字並秘書賜之。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong wrote the characters "Loyal and Filial Li Zhang" together with a secretarial text and bestowed them on him.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong wrote the words "Loyal and Filial Li Zhang" along with an imperial inscription and bestowed them on him.

sentences.zh: 宴近臣群玉殿，酒半，命大盞二，飲韓琦及璋，如有所屬。

translations.literal: At a banquet for close ministers in the Qunyu Hall, when the wine was half finished, he ordered two large cups and had Han Qi and Zhang drink, as though he had someone in mind.
translations.idiomatic: At a banquet for close ministers in the Qunyu Hall, when the wine was half gone he ordered two large cups and had Han Qi and Zhang drink, as though he had someone particular in mind.

sentences.zh: 帝崩，執政欲增京城甲 士，璋曰：「例出累代，不宜輒易。」

translations.literal: When the emperor died, those in power wished to increase the armored soldiers in the capital. Zhang said, "The precedent comes from successive generations and should not be changed lightly."
translations.idiomatic: After the emperor died, those in power wanted to increase the number of armored soldiers in the capital. Zhang said, "This practice comes from generations of precedent and should not be changed lightly."

sentences.zh: 時禁衛相告乾興故事，內給食物中有金，既而果賜食，眾視食中，璋曰：「天子未臨政已優賞，汝何功復云云，敢喧者斬！」

translations.literal: At that time the palace guards told one another the story of the Qianxing era, that gold was hidden in the food supplied within the palace. Soon afterward food was indeed granted, and the crowd looked inside the food. Zhang said, "The Son of Heaven has not yet taken charge of government and has already rewarded you generously. What merit do you have to go on like this? Whoever dares make a clamor shall be beheaded!"
translations.idiomatic: At that time the palace guards whispered to one another about the Qianxing precedent, in which gold had been hidden in the food supplied within the palace. When food was indeed granted, the men looked inside it. Zhang said, "The Son of Heaven has not yet begun to rule and has already rewarded you generously. What merit do you have to keep clamoring? Anyone who makes a disturbance will be executed!"

sentences.zh: 眾乃定。

translations.literal: The crowd then settled down.
translations.idiomatic: The crowd then settled down.

sentences.zh: 以武成軍節度使知鄆州。

translations.literal: As Military Governor of Wucheng Army he served as Prefect of Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: As military governor of Wucheng Army, he served as prefect of Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 京東盜白日殺縣令，略人道中，璋信賞罰擒捕，盜為衰止。

translations.literal: Bandits in Jingdong murdered a county magistrate in broad daylight and plundered travelers on the roads. Zhang relied on rewards and punishments to capture them, and banditry declined and ceased.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingdong, bandits murdered a county magistrate in broad daylight and robbed travelers on the roads. Zhang enforced rewards and punishments to capture them, and banditry waned.

sentences.zh: 歲大雨水，競以船筏邀利，多溺死者，璋一切籍之，約所 勝載如黃河法。

translations.literal: In a year of heavy rain and flooding, people competed to use boats and rafts for profit, and many drowned. Zhang registered them all and regulated their loading capacity according to the Yellow River regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In a year of heavy rain and flooding, people competed to profit from boats and rafts, and many drowned. Zhang registered them all and set loading limits according to the Yellow River regulations.

sentences.zh: 發卒城州西關，調夫修路數十里，夾道植柳，人指為「李公柳」。

translations.literal: He mobilized soldiers to fortify the western pass of the prefecture, conscripted laborers to repair the road for several tens of li, and planted willows on both sides of the road. People pointed to them as "Lord Li's Willows."
translations.idiomatic: He mobilized soldiers to fortify the western pass of the prefecture, conscripted laborers to repair the road for dozens of li, and planted willows along both sides. People called them "Lord Li's Willows."

sentences.zh: 知鄧州，坐失舉，改節振武軍，知郢州。

translations.literal: As Prefect of Deng Prefecture, he was punished for a failure in recommendation and was transferred to Military Governor of Zhenwu Army and Prefect of Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: While serving as prefect of Deng Prefecture, he was punished for a failure in recommendation and was transferred to military governor of Zhenwu Army and prefect of Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 還朝，道卒，年五十三。

translations.literal: On his return to court he died on the road, aged fifty-three.
translations.idiomatic: On his way back to court he died on the road, at the age of fifty-three.

sentences.zh: 贈太尉，諡曰良 惠。

translations.literal: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Marshal, and his posthumous title was Lianghui.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously enfeoffed as grand marshal and given the posthumous title Lianghui.

sentences.zh: 弟瑋、珣。

translations.literal: His younger brothers were Wei and Xun.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brothers were Wei and Xun.

sentences.zh: 珣字公粹，以蔭為閣門祗候。

translations.literal: Xun, courtesy name Gongcui, by hereditary privilege became Attendant of the Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Xun, courtesy name Gongcui, entered service by hereditary privilege as attendant of the gate.

sentences.zh: 時兄璋為閣門副使，珣又求通事舍人，仁宗曰：「爵賞所以與天下共也，儻盡用親戚，何以待勳舊乎？」

translations.literal: At the time his elder brother Zhang was Deputy Gate Commissioner, and Xun again requested appointment as Imperial Herald. Emperor Renzong said, "Titles and rewards are meant to be shared with all under Heaven. If we use only relatives, how shall we treat meritorious veterans?"
translations.idiomatic: At the time his elder brother Zhang was deputy gate commissioner, and Xun also sought appointment as imperial herald. Emperor Renzong said, "Titles and rewards are meant to be shared with all under Heaven. If we use only relatives, how are we to treat meritorious veterans?"

sentences.zh: 後一年乃命之。

translations.literal: Only after another year was he appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Only a year later was he appointed.

sentences.zh: 車駕視用和疾，自西上閣門副使累遷均州防禦使，知相州，賜御製詩、飛白字寵其行。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage visited Yonghe in his illness, Xun rose from Deputy Gate Commissioner of the Western Upper Gate through successive promotions to Defense Commissioner of Jun Prefecture and Prefect of Xiang Prefecture. The emperor bestowed an imperially composed poem and flying-white calligraphy to honor his departure.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor visited Yonghe during his illness, Xun rose from deputy gate commissioner of the Western Upper Gate through successive promotions to defense commissioner of Jun Prefecture and prefect of Xiang Prefecture. The emperor bestowed an imperial poem and flying-white calligraphy to honor his departure.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷相州觀察使。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to Observation Commissioner of Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to observation commissioner of Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時劉永年亦同除官，知制誥楊畋以為不可開僥幸之門，詔他舍人草制，御史範鎮復論之，命遂寢。

translations.literal: At the time Liu Yongnian was also appointed to office at the same time. Drafting Secretary Yang Tian held that one must not open the door to opportunism, and the edict ordered another drafter to compose the appointment document. Censor Fan Zhen again argued against it, and the appointment was then dropped.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Liu Yongnian received a concurrent appointment. Drafting secretary Yang Tian argued that this would open the door to opportunism, and the edict had another drafter compose the appointment document. Censor Fan Zhen argued against it again, and the appointment was dropped.

sentences.zh: 使契丹，預釣魚會，獲多。

translations.literal: On a mission to the Khitan, he took part in the Fishing Assembly and caught many fish.
translations.idiomatic: On a mission to the Khitan, he took part in the Fishing Assembly and caught a great many fish.

sentences.zh: 契丹遺以金器，使還，悉上之，更賜黃金及「李珣忠孝」字。

translations.literal: The Khitan presented him with gold vessels. When the mission returned, he submitted them all to the throne and was in turn granted gold and the characters "Loyal and Filial Li Xun."
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan gave him gold vessels. When he returned from the mission, he submitted them all to the throne and was rewarded with gold and the inscription "Loyal and Filial Li Xun."

sentences.zh: 熙寧中，遷宣州觀察使、知潁州，哲宗初，進泰寧軍留後，提舉萬壽觀。

translations.literal: During the Xining era he was transferred to Observation Commissioner of Xuan Prefecture and Prefect of Ying Prefecture. At the beginning of Emperor Zhezong's reign he was promoted to Acting Governor of Taining Army and put in charge of the Wanshou Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xining era he was transferred to observation commissioner of Xuan Prefecture and prefect of Ying Prefecture. At the beginning of Emperor Zhezong's reign he was promoted to acting governor of Taining Army and put in charge of the Wanshou Abbey.

sentences.zh: 故事，正任遇覃恩止移鎮，唯宗室乃遷官。

translations.literal: By precedent, when regular appointees encountered a general amnesty they were only transferred to another commandery; only members of the imperial clan were promoted in office.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, when regular appointees received a general amnesty they were only transferred to another commandery; only members of the imperial clan were promoted in rank.

sentences.zh: 至是，珣與李端愨皆特遷，戚裏一覃恩遷官自此始。

translations.literal: At this time both Xun and Li Duanyi received special promotions, and from this began the promotion in office of imperial consort kin during a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: At this point both Xun and Li Duanyi received special promotions, marking the first time imperial consort kin were promoted during a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 復知相州，卒，年七十四。

translations.literal: He again served as Prefect of Xiang Prefecture, then died, aged seventy-four.
translations.idiomatic: He again served as prefect of Xiang Prefecture, then died at the age of seventy-four.

sentences.zh: 李遵勖字公武，崇矩孫，繼昌子也。

translations.literal: Li Zunxu, courtesy name Gongwu, was the grandson of Chongju and the son of Jichang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zunxu, courtesy name Gongwu, was the grandson of Chongju and the son of Jichang.

sentences.zh: 生數歲，相者曰：「是當以姻戚貴。」

translations.literal: When he was several years old, a physiognomist said, "This one will become noble through marriage kinship."
translations.idiomatic: When he was only a few years old, a physiognomist said, "This child will rise to nobility through imperial marriage."

sentences.zh: 少學騎射，馳冰雪間，馬逸，墜崖下，眾以為死，遵勖徐起，亡恙也。

translations.literal: In youth he studied horsemanship and archery. Galloping through ice and snow, his horse bolted and he fell off a cliff. The crowd thought him dead, but Zunxu slowly rose, unharmed.
translations.idiomatic: As a youth he studied horsemanship and archery. While galloping through ice and snow, his horse bolted and he fell off a cliff. The onlookers thought he was dead, but Zunxu slowly got up unharmed.

sentences.zh: 及長，好為文詞，舉進士。

translations.literal: When he grew up, he loved composing literary pieces and passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: When he grew up, he loved literary composition and passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符間，召對便殿，尚萬壽長公主。

translations.literal: During the Dazhong Xiangfu era he was summoned for audience in the side hall and married Princess Wanshou the Elder.
translations.idiomatic: During the Dazhong Xiangfu era he was summoned for audience in the side hall and married Princess Wanshou the Elder.

sentences.zh: 初名勖，帝益「遵」字，升其行為崇矩子。

translations.literal: His original name was Xu; the emperor added the character "Zun" and raised his place in the family line to make him the son of Chongju.
translations.idiomatic: His original name was Xu; the emperor added the character "Zun" to his name and raised his place in the family line to make him the son of Chongju.

sentences.zh: 授左龍武將軍、駙馬都尉，賜第永寧裏。

translations.literal: He was appointed General of the Left Dragon Martial Guard and Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant, and was granted a residence in Yongning Lane.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed general of the Left Dragon Martial Guard and imperial son-in-law commandant, and was granted a residence in Yongning Lane.

sentences.zh: 主下嫁，而所居堂甃或瓦甓多為鸞鳳狀，遵勖令鑱去；

translations.literal: When the princess came down to marry, the tiles and bricks of the hall in which she was to live were often in the shapes of phoenixes. Zunxu ordered them chiseled away;
translations.idiomatic: When the princess came to marry him, many of the tiles and bricks in her hall were shaped like phoenixes. Zunxu had them chiseled away;

sentences.zh: 主服有龍飾，悉屏藏之，帝歎喜。

translations.literal: the princess's garments bore dragon ornamentation, and he had them all removed and hidden away. The emperor sighed in delight.
translations.idiomatic: her garments bore dragon ornamentation, and he had them all removed and hidden away. The emperor sighed in delight.

sentences.zh: 領澄州刺史，坐私主乳母，謫均州團練使，徙蔡州。

translations.literal: He held the post of Prefect of Cheng Prefecture, but was punished for having relations with the princess's wet nurse and was demoted to Regimental Commissioner of Jun Prefecture, then transferred to Cai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He served as prefect of Cheng Prefecture, but was punished for having relations with the princess's wet nurse and was demoted to regimental commissioner of Jun Prefecture, then transferred to Cai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 逾年，起為太子左衛率府副率，復左龍武軍將軍，領宏州團練使，真拜康州團練使，給觀察使祿。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was recalled to serve as Deputy Commandant of the Left Guard of the Heir Apparent's Left Guard Office, restored as General of the Left Dragon Martial Guard, appointed Regimental Commissioner of Hong Prefecture, formally appointed Regimental Commissioner of Kang Prefecture, and granted an observation commissioner's salary.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he was recalled as deputy commandant of the Left Guard of the Heir Apparent's Left Guard Office, restored as general of the Left Dragon Martial Guard, appointed regimental commissioner of Hong Prefecture, formally appointed regimental commissioner of Kang Prefecture, and granted an observation commissioner's salary.

sentences.zh: 時繼昌官刺 史，遵勖請班其下，許之。

translations.literal: At the time Jichang held the office of prefect, and Zunxu requested to rank below him; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Jichang held the office of prefect, and Zunxu asked to rank below him; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 後繼昌守涇州，暴感風眩，遵勖馳省不俟命，帝遣使令乘驛赴之。

translations.literal: Later, when Jichang was defending Jing Prefecture and suddenly suffered a violent attack of dizziness, Zunxu rushed to visit him without awaiting orders. The emperor sent a messenger ordering him to take post-horses and go.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Jichang was defending Jing Prefecture and suddenly suffered a violent dizzy spell, Zunxu rushed to visit him without awaiting orders. The emperor sent a messenger ordering him to take post-horses and go.

sentences.zh: 既還，上表自劾，帝使輔臣慰諭之。

translations.literal: After he returned, he submitted a memorial impeaching himself, and the emperor had assisting ministers console and instruct him.
translations.idiomatic: After he returned, he submitted a memorial impeaching himself, and the emperor had assisting ministers console and reassure him.

sentences.zh: 遷澤州防禦使，又遷 宣州觀察使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Defense Commissioner of Ze Prefecture, and again transferred to Observation Commissioner of Xuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to defense commissioner of Ze Prefecture, and then to observation commissioner of Xuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 求補郡自試，出知澶州，賜宴長春殿。

translations.literal: He requested appointment to a prefecture to test himself, went out to serve as Prefect of Cao Prefecture, and was granted a banquet in the Changchun Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to be sent to a prefecture to prove himself, went out to serve as prefect of Cao Prefecture, and was granted a banquet in the Changchun Hall.

sentences.zh: 在郡，會河水溢，將壞浮梁，遵勖督工徒，七日而堤成。

translations.literal: While in the prefecture, the river overflowed and was about to destroy the pontoon bridge. Zunxu supervised the workers, and in seven days the embankment was completed.
translations.idiomatic: While serving in the prefecture, the river overflowed and threatened to destroy the pontoon bridge. Zunxu supervised the workers, and the embankment was completed in seven days.

sentences.zh: 遷昭德軍節度觀察留後，拜寧國軍節度使，徙鎮國軍、 知許州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Acting Military Governor and Observation Commissioner of Zhaode Army, appointed Military Governor of Ningguo Army, and transferred to Zhenguo Army and Prefect of Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to acting military governor and observation commissioner of Zhaode Army, appointed military governor of Ningguo Army, and transferred to Zhenguo Army as prefect of Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 水軍多不練習而隸籍，遵勖命部校按劾，拔去十七八。

translations.literal: Many of the naval troops were unskilled yet remained on the rolls. Zunxu ordered the unit officers to investigate and dismiss them, removing seven or eight out of ten.
translations.idiomatic: Many naval troops were unskilled yet remained on the rolls. Zunxu ordered the unit officers to investigate and dismiss them, removing seven or eight out of ten.

sentences.zh: 復以疾請援唐韋嗣立故事，求山林號，詔不許。

translations.literal: Again on account of illness he requested, citing the Tang precedent of Wei Silizhi, a mountain-and-forest title; the edict did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: Again citing illness, he requested a mountain-and-forest title on the Tang precedent of Wei Silizhi, but the edict denied the request.

sentences.zh: 初，天聖間，章獻太后屏左右問曰：「 人有何言？」

translations.literal: At first, during the Tiansheng era, Empress Dowager Zhangxian dismissed those around her and asked, "What are people saying?"
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tiansheng era, Empress Dowager Zhangxian dismissed those around her and asked, "What are people saying?"

sentences.zh: 遵勖不答。

translations.literal: Zunxu did not answer.
translations.idiomatic: Zunxu did not answer.

sentences.zh: 太后固問之，遵勖曰：「臣無他聞，但人言天子既冠，太后宜以時還政。」

translations.literal: The empress dowager pressed him further. Zunxu said, "Your subject has heard nothing else, but people say that since the Son of Heaven has already come of age, the empress dowager ought to return power at the proper time."
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager pressed him. Zunxu said, "Your subject has heard nothing else, but people say that since the Son of Heaven has already come of age, the empress dowager ought to return power at the proper time."

sentences.zh: 太后曰：「我非戀此，但帝少，內侍多，恐未能製之也。」

translations.literal: The empress dowager said, "It is not that I cling to this, but the emperor is young, the inner attendants are many, and I fear he may not yet be able to control them."
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager said, "It is not that I cling to power, but the emperor is young, the inner attendants are many, and I fear he may not yet be able to control them."

sentences.zh: 嘗上 三說五事以論時政。

translations.literal: He once submitted Three Propositions and Five Matters to discuss current policy.
translations.idiomatic: He once submitted Three Propositions and Five Matters to discuss current affairs.

sentences.zh: 晉國夫人林氏，以太后乳母，多干預國事，太后崩，遵勖密請置之別院，出入伺察之，以厭服眾論。

translations.literal: Lady Lin, Lady of the State of Jin, as the empress dowager's wet nurse often meddled in state affairs. When the empress dowager died, Zunxu secretly requested that she be placed in a separate residence and that her comings and goings be watched, so as to satisfy public opinion.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Lin, Lady of the State of Jin, the empress dowager's wet nurse, often meddled in state affairs. When the empress dowager died, Zunxu secretly asked that she be placed in a separate residence and that her comings and goings be watched, so as to satisfy public opinion.

sentences.zh: 其補助居多類此。

translations.literal: Most of his assistance was of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: Most of his assistance to the throne was of this kind.

sentences.zh: 所居第園池 冠京城。

translations.literal: The garden and pond of his residence were foremost in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The garden and pond of his residence were the finest in the capital.

sentences.zh: 嗜奇石，募人載送，有自千里至者。

translations.literal: He was fond of strange stones, recruited people to transport them, and some came from as far as a thousand li away.
translations.idiomatic: He loved strange stones and hired people to transport them; some came from as far as a thousand li away.

sentences.zh: 構堂引水，環以佳木，延一時名士大夫與宴樂。

translations.literal: He built a hall and drew in water, surrounded it with fine trees, and invited famous scholar-officials of the time to feast and enjoy themselves.
translations.idiomatic: He built a hall and channeled water into it, surrounded it with fine trees, and invited celebrated scholar-officials of the day to feast and enjoy themselves.

sentences.zh: 師楊億為文，億卒，為製服。

translations.literal: He took Yang Yi as his teacher in literary composition. When Yi died, he wore mourning garments for him.
translations.idiomatic: He studied literary composition under Yang Yi. When Yi died, he wore mourning for him.

sentences.zh: 及知許州，奠億之墓，慟哭而返。

translations.literal: When he served as Prefect of Xu Prefecture, he offered sacrifices at Yi's tomb, wept bitterly, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: When he served as prefect of Xu Prefecture, he offered sacrifices at Yi's tomb, wept bitterly, and returned.

sentences.zh: 又與劉 筠相友善，筠卒，存恤其家。

translations.literal: He was also on friendly terms with Liu Yun. When Yun died, he supported and comforted his family.
translations.idiomatic: He was also on friendly terms with Liu Yun. When Yun died, he supported and comforted his family.

sentences.zh: 通釋氏學，將死，與浮圖楚圓為偈頌。

translations.literal: He was versed in Buddhist learning, and on the verge of death composed gatha verses with the monk Chuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was versed in Buddhist learning, and on the verge of death composed gatha verses with the monk Chuyuan.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈中書令，諡曰和文。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Director of the Secretariat, with the posthumous title Hewen.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously enfeoffed as director of the Secretariat, with the posthumous title Hewen.

sentences.zh: 有《間宴集》二十卷，《外館芳題》七卷。

translations.literal: He had twenty juan of Leisure Banquet Collection and seven juan of Fragrant Titles from the Outer Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: He authored twenty juan of Leisure Banquet Collection and seven juan of Fragrant Titles from the Outer Lodge.

sentences.zh: 子端懿。

translations.literal: His son was Duanyi.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Duanyi.

sentences.zh: 端懿字元伯，性和厚，喜問學，頗通陰陽、醫術、星經、地理之學。

translations.literal: Duanyi, courtesy name Yuanbo, was mild and generous by nature, loved inquiry and learning, and was quite versed in yin-yang lore, medicine, astral classics, and geomancy.
translations.idiomatic: Duanyi, courtesy name Yuanbo, was mild and generous by nature, loved learning, and was well versed in yin-yang lore, medicine, astral classics, and geomancy.

sentences.zh: 七歲，授如京副使。

translations.literal: At the age of seven he was appointed Deputy Commissioner of the Capital Transport Office.
translations.idiomatic: At the age of seven he was appointed deputy commissioner of the Capital Transport Office.

sentences.zh: 侍真宗東宮，尤所親愛，嘗解方玉帶賜之。

translations.literal: He attended Emperor Zhenzong in the Eastern Palace and was especially beloved by him; the emperor once removed his square jade belt and bestowed it on him.
translations.idiomatic: He attended Emperor Zhenzong in the Eastern Palace and was especially beloved by him; the emperor once removed his square jade belt and bestowed it on him.

sentences.zh: 稍長，出入宮禁如家人。

translations.literal: When he grew a little older, he entered and left the palace precincts like a member of the family.
translations.idiomatic: As he grew older, he entered and left the palace precincts like a member of the family.

sentences.zh: 七遷濟州防禦使，為群牧副使。

translations.literal: Through seven promotions he became Defense Commissioner of Ji Prefecture and Deputy Commissioner of the Pasturage Office.
translations.idiomatic: Through seven promotions he became defense commissioner of Ji Prefecture and deputy commissioner of the Pasturage Office.

sentences.zh: 杜衍為樞密，擇外戚子弟試外官，乃以端懿知冀州。

translations.literal: When Du Yan served as Military Affairs Commissioner, he selected sons and younger brothers of imperial consort kin to test them in external office, and thus appointed Duanyi Prefect of Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Du Yan served as military affairs commissioner, he selected sons and younger brothers of imperial consort kin to test them in external office, and thus appointed Duanyi prefect of Ji Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 為政循法度，民愛其不擾。

translations.literal: In governing he followed law and regulation, and the people loved him for not disturbing them.
translations.idiomatic: In governing he followed law and regulation, and the people loved him for leaving them undisturbed.

sentences.zh: 轉運使移州捕妖人李教，教已死。

translations.literal: The transport commissioner ordered the prefecture to arrest the sorcerer Li Jiao, but Jiao was already dead.
translations.idiomatic: The transport commissioner ordered the prefecture to arrest the sorcerer Li Jiao, but Jiao was already dead.

sentences.zh: 恩州王則據城 叛，人有言教不死，在賊軍中。

translations.literal: Wang Ze of En Prefecture seized the city and rebelled. Some said Jiao was not dead and was in the rebel army.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ze of En Prefecture seized the city and rebelled. Some said Jiao was not dead and was among the rebels.

sentences.zh: 遂降單州團練使、知均州，改滑州兵馬鈐轄。

translations.literal: He was therefore demoted to Regimental Commissioner of Shan Prefecture and Prefect of Jun Prefecture, and transferred to Military Controller of Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was therefore demoted to regimental commissioner of Shan Prefecture and prefect of Jun Prefecture, and transferred to military controller of Hua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 賊平，實無李教者，乃以為汝州防禦使、提舉在京諸司庫務。

translations.literal: When the rebels were pacified, there was in fact no Li Jiao, and he was then appointed Defense Commissioner of Ru Prefecture and put in charge of the storehouses and offices in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels were pacified, there was in fact no Li Jiao, and he was then appointed defense commissioner of Ru Prefecture and put in charge of the storehouses and offices in the capital.

sentences.zh: 遷蔡州觀察使、同勾當三班院。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Observation Commissioner of Cai Prefecture and concurrently put in charge of the Third Rank Office.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to observation commissioner of Cai Prefecture and concurrently put in charge of the Third Rank Office.

sentences.zh: 徙華州觀察使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Observation Commissioner of Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to observation commissioner of Hua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以母喪，起復為鎮國軍節度觀察留後，願終製，許之，仍給全奉。

translations.literal: During mourning for his mother, he was recalled from mourning to serve as Acting Military Governor and Observation Commissioner of Zhenguo Army. He wished to complete his mourning period, and this was granted, while his full salary was still paid.
translations.idiomatic: During mourning for his mother, he was recalled from mourning to serve as acting military governor and observation commissioner of Zhenguo Army. He asked to complete his mourning period, and this was granted while his full salary was still paid.

sentences.zh: 服除，提舉集禧觀，出知鄆州兼京東西路安撫使。

translations.literal: When mourning ended, he was put in charge of the Jixi Abbey, went out to serve as Prefect of Yan Prefecture, and concurrently served as Pacification Commissioner of the Jingdong and Jingxi Circuits.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended, he was put in charge of the Jixi Abbey, went out to serve as prefect of Yan Prefecture, and concurrently served as pacification commissioner of the Jingdong and Jingxi Circuits.

sentences.zh: 是歲，京東水，民多饑，大發倉廩以賑之。

translations.literal: That year Jingdong flooded, many of the people went hungry, and he greatly opened the granaries to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: That year Jingdong flooded, many people went hungry, and he opened the granaries on a large scale to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 置弓手局，教以戰鬥，遂如精兵。

translations.literal: He established an archers' bureau, trained them in combat, and they became like elite troops.
translations.idiomatic: He established an archers' bureau, trained them in combat, and they became as good as elite troops.

sentences.zh: 治汶陽堤百餘里，以卻水患，民便之。

translations.literal: He repaired the Wenyang embankment for more than a hundred li to repel flood damage, and the people found it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: He repaired the Wenyang embankment for more than a hundred li to ward off flooding, to the people's benefit.

sentences.zh: 尋除寧遠軍節度使、知澶州。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed Military Governor of Ningyuan Army and Prefect of Cao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed military governor of Ningyuan Army and prefect of Cao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞韓絳奏端懿無功，不當得旄節，不拜。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Han Jiang memorialized that Duan Yi had no achievements and should not receive the banner and credentials; Duan Yi did not accept the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Han Jiang memorialized that Duan Yi had no meritorious service and did not deserve the banner and credentials; Duan Yi declined the appointment.

sentences.zh: 以留後赴澶州，數月卒。

translations.literal: As acting military governor he went to Cao Prefecture and died several months later.
translations.idiomatic: He proceeded to Cao Prefecture as acting military governor and died several months later.

sentences.zh: 訃聞，帝方宴禁中，為徹樂，贈其家黃金三百兩，贈感德軍節度使，諡良定，再贈兼侍中。

translations.literal: When word of his death arrived, the Emperor had been feasting within the palace; on his account the music was stopped; he bestowed upon his family three hundred taels of gold, posthumously appointed him Military Governor of Gande Army, gave him the posthumous name Liangding, and further posthumously appointed him as Concurrent Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: When word of his death arrived, the Emperor had been feasting in the palace. He ordered the music stopped and bestowed three hundred taels of gold upon the family. Duan Yi was posthumously made military governor of Gande Army, given the posthumous name Liangding, and further posthumously appointed concurrent Secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 端懿能自刻厲，聞善士，傾身下之，以故士大夫與之遊，甚得名譽。

translations.literal: Duan Yi was able to restrain and discipline himself; when he heard of worthy gentlemen, he humbled himself to them; for this reason scholar-officials associated with him and he gained considerable reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Yi was able to discipline himself strictly. When he heard of worthy gentlemen, he would humble himself before them. Scholar-officials therefore sought his company, and he enjoyed considerable renown.

sentences.zh: 弟端願。

translations.literal: His younger brother was Duan Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother was Duan Yuan.

sentences.zh: 端願字公謹，以穆獻公主恩，七歲授如京副使，四遷為恩州團練使。

translations.literal: Duan Yuan, courtesy name Gongjin, due to the favor of Princess Mu-Xian, at age seven was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Capital, and after four promotions became Regimental Commander of En Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Yuan, courtesy name Gongjin, through Princess Mu-Xian's favor received at age seven the post of vice commissioner of the capital. After four promotions he became regimental commander of En Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 仁宗以歲旱，禦便殿慮囚，放宮女。

translations.literal: Because of drought that year, Emperor Renzong held court at the informal hall to review prisoners and released palace women.
translations.idiomatic: When drought struck that year, Emperor Renzong held court at the informal hall to review prisoners and released palace women.

sentences.zh: 端願上疏，謂：「縱釋有罪，小人之幸；

translations.literal: Duan Yuan submitted a memorial, stating: "Freeing those who are guilty is the good fortune of petty men;
translations.idiomatic: Duan Yuan submitted a memorial, saying: "Releasing the guilty is a boon to petty men;

sentences.zh: 放宮女為宦者專製，反失所歸，何以弭災變？」

translations.literal: releasing palace women for eunuchs to manage exclusively, on the contrary leaves them with nowhere to go — how can this extinguish calamities and portents?"
translations.idiomatic: and releasing palace women for eunuchs to control exclusively leaves them with nowhere to go. How can this avert disasters and portents?"

sentences.zh: 累進邢州觀察使、鎮東軍留後，知襄、郢二州。

translations.literal: He was successively promoted to Inspector of Xing Prefecture and Acting Military Governor of Zhendong Army, and served as Prefect of Xiang and Ying Prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He was successively promoted to inspector of Xing Prefecture and acting military governor of Zhendong Army, and served as prefect of Xiang and Ying Prefectures.

sentences.zh: 本路轉運使獻羨財數十萬被賞，端願言常賦三折，其民不堪，即上其事。

translations.literal: The transport commissioner of the circuit presented surplus revenue of several hundred thousand and was rewarded; Duan Yuan said the regular tax had been assessed at three-tenths, which the people could not bear, and immediately reported the matter.
translations.idiomatic: When the circuit transport commissioner presented surplus revenue of several hundred thousand and was rewarded, Duan Yuan reported that the regular tax rate had been tripled and the people could not bear it. He immediately submitted the matter to the throne.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，奪轉運使賞，申折變之禁。

translations.literal: The Emperor was angry, stripped the transport commissioner of his reward, and proclaimed the prohibition on tax conversion.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was angered, stripped the transport commissioner of his reward, and reiterated the prohibition on tax conversion.

sentences.zh: 移廬 州，富弼謂曰：「肥上之政何以減於襄陽？」

translations.literal: After he was transferred to Lu Prefecture, Fu Bi said to him: "Why is your governance at Feishang inferior to that at Xiangyang?"
translations.idiomatic: After he was transferred to Lu Prefecture, Fu Bi said to him: "Why is your governance at Feishang not as good as it was at Xiangyang?"

sentences.zh: 端願曰：「初官喜事，飾廚傳以幹名，則譽者至；

translations.literal: Duan Yuan said: "When I first took office I was eager for achievement; if I furnished guest quarters to seek reputation, praise would arrive;
translations.idiomatic: Duan Yuan replied: "When I first took office I was eager to make a name for myself. If I furnished guest quarters to cultivate reputation, praise would follow;

sentences.zh: 更事既久，知抑豪強、製猾吏，故毀隨之。」

translations.literal: having held office a long time, I know how to restrain powerful families and control crafty officials, and so slander followed."
translations.idiomatic: but after long experience in office I learned to restrain powerful families and control crafty officials, and so slander followed."

sentences.zh: 弼深然其言。

translations.literal: Fu Bi deeply agreed with his words.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Bi strongly agreed with his explanation.

sentences.zh: 英宗初，同提舉在京諸司庫務。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Yingzong's reign, he concurrently supervised the various treasury offices in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Yingzong's reign, he was appointed to jointly supervise the various treasury offices in the capital.

sentences.zh: 帝以疾拱默，端願求對，進曰：「陛下當躬攬權綱，以係人心，不宜退托，失天下望。」

translations.literal: The Emperor, ill, sat in silence; Duan Yuan requested an audience and advanced, saying: "Your Majesty should personally grasp the reins of power to bind the hearts of men; you should not withdraw and entrust affairs to others and lose the hopes of all under Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, ill, remained silent; Duan Yuan requested an audience and said: "Your Majesty should personally grasp the reins of authority to hold the people's loyalty. You should not withdraw from affairs and surrender them to others, lest you lose the people's hope."

sentences.zh: 拜武康軍節度使、知相州。

translations.literal: He was appointed Military Governor of Wukang Army and Prefect of Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed military governor of Wukang Army and prefect of Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 請歸，除醴泉觀使。

translations.literal: He requested to retire and was appointed Director of the Liquan Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: He requested retirement and was appointed director of the Liquan Abbey.

sentences.zh: 神宗即位，遣使就其家錄取異時章奏，賜詔褒之。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shenzong ascended the throne, he sent envoys to his home to collect memorials from earlier times and bestowed an edict praising him.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shenzong ascended the throne, he sent envoys to Duan Yuan's home to collect his earlier memorials and issued an edict praising him.

sentences.zh: 河東城囉兀，端願手寫趙普《諫太宗北伐疏》以聞。

translations.literal: When the fortress of Luowu was built in Hedong, Duan Yuan copied Zhao Pu's Memorial Admonishing Taizong's Northern Campaign and submitted it to inform the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: When the fortress of Luowu was built in Hedong, Duan Yuan copied Zhao Pu's Memorial Admonishing Taizong's Northern Campaign and submitted it to the throne.

sentences.zh: 連年請老，以太子少保致仕。

translations.literal: For many years he requested old age and retired with the title of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: For many years he requested retirement and finally stepped down with the title of junior guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 凡大禮成，賜金帶、器幣，品數視執政。

translations.literal: Whenever major rites were completed, he was granted golden belts and ritual objects, in quantity equal to the chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever major state rites were completed, he received golden belts and ritual gifts in quantity equal to those granted chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 哲宗嗣位，進太子太保。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhezong succeeded to the throne, he was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhezong succeeded to the throne, he was promoted to grand guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 欽聖皇后以甥舅之故，嘗幸其第，致禮於獻穆祠堂，命近侍掖端願勿拜。
