translations.idiomatic: The accusers did not stop. His rank and titles were stripped and he was exiled to Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 行二日，聽家居省咎。

translations.literal: After two days on the road, he was permitted to remain at home to reflect on his faults.
translations.idiomatic: After two days on the road, he was permitted to remain at home to reflect on his faults.

sentences.zh: 逾年，盡還其故官。

translations.literal: After more than a year, all his former offices were fully restored.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year, all his former offices were fully restored.

sentences.zh: 宗回少驕恣，有小才，嘗權群牧都監，數以蕃息被賞。

translations.literal: Zonghui in youth was arrogant and willful, had some small talent, once acted as Overall Supervisor of the Pasturage Offices, and was repeatedly rewarded for increasing the herds.
translations.idiomatic: Zonghui in youth was arrogant and willful and had some small talent. He once acted as overall supervisor of the pasturage offices and was repeatedly rewarded for increasing the herds.

sentences.zh: 出知蔡州，擒劇賊，殲其黨類。

translations.literal: He went out to command Cai Prefecture, captured major bandits, and exterminated their gangs.
translations.idiomatic: He went out to command Cai Prefecture, captured major bandits, and exterminated their gangs.

sentences.zh: 歲饑，發廩興力役，饑者得濟，而官舍帑廩一新。

translations.literal: In a year of famine he opened the granaries and launched public works; the hungry were relieved, and the official buildings and storehouses were all renewed.
translations.idiomatic: In a year of famine he opened the granaries and launched public works. The hungry were relieved, and the official buildings and storehouses were all renewed.

sentences.zh: 欽聖後服除，起奉朝請，繼命止朝朔望。

translations.literal: When mourning for Empress Qinsheng ended, he was reinstated as Court Attendant; subsequently he was ordered to attend court only on the first and fifteenth of the month.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning for Empress Qinsheng ended, he was reinstated as court attendant. Subsequently he was ordered to attend court only on the first and fifteenth of the month.

sentences.zh: 卒，年六十二，帝制服苑中，贈檢校少師，諡曰榮縱。

translations.literal: He died at the age of sixty-two; the Emperor wore mourning in the imperial garden; he was posthumously granted Honorary Junior Preceptor and given the posthumous title Rongzong.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of sixty-two. The Emperor wore mourning in the imperial garden. He was posthumously granted honorary junior preceptor and given the posthumous title Rongzong.

sentences.zh: 宗良字景弼，曆秀州刺史、利州觀察使、昭信軍留後，奉國、清海、鎮東、武寧、寧海軍節度使，永嘉郡王，開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Zongliang, courtesy name Jingbi, successively served as Prefect of Xiu Prefecture, Inspector of Li Prefecture, Acting Military Governor of Zhaoxin Army, Military Governor of Fengguo, Qinghai, Zhendong, Wuning, and Ninghai Armies, Prince of Yongjia Commandery, and Grand Master with the same ceremony as the Three Councillors.
translations.idiomatic: Zongliang, courtesy name Jingbi, successively served as prefect of Xiu Prefecture, inspector of Li Prefecture, acting military governor of Zhaoxin Army, military governor of Fengguo, Qinghai, Zhendong, Wuning, and Ninghai Armies, prince of Yongjia Commandery, and grand master with ceremonial standing equal to the Three Councillors.

sentences.zh: 欽聖後臨朝時，嘗為陳瓘論其與蔡京相結。

translations.literal: When Empress Qinsheng held court, Chen Guan once criticized his collusion with Cai Jing.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Qinsheng held court, Chen Guan once criticized his collusion with Cai Jing.

sentences.zh: 及預政事，亦能恪共自守。

translations.literal: When he participated in governance, he was also able to be diligent and guard himself.
translations.idiomatic: When he participated in governance, he was also able to be diligent and guard himself.

sentences.zh: 宣和中，卒，年六十六，贈少保。

translations.literal: During Xuanhe he died at the age of sixty-six and was posthumously granted Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: During Xuanhe he died at the age of sixty-six and was posthumously granted junior guardian.

sentences.zh: 章惇為政，言：「敦禮忘德犯分，醜正朋邪。

translations.literal: When Zhang Dun held power he said: "Dunli forgot virtue and overstepped his station, vilified the upright and befriended the wicked.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Dun held power he said: "Dunli forgot virtue and overstepped his station, vilified the upright and befriended the wicked.

sentences.zh: 密封章疏，詆毀先烈。

translations.literal: In sealed memorials he slandered the former worthies.
translations.idiomatic: In sealed memorials he slandered the former worthies.

sentences.zh: 引譽罪首，謂當褒崇，欲其黨儔盡見收用。」

translations.literal: He praised the chief culprits and said they should be honored, wishing that all their partisans be fully employed."
translations.idiomatic: He praised the chief culprits and said they should be honored, wishing that all their partisans be fully employed."

sentences.zh: 乃責授左千牛衛大將軍，勒止朝參。

translations.literal: He was thereupon demoted to General of the Left Thousand-Ox Guard and forbidden to attend court.
translations.idiomatic: He was thereupon demoted to general of the Left Thousand-Ox Guard and forbidden to attend court.

sentences.zh: 徽宗立，有 司以敦禮在貴籍，奏審恩賜，帝與欽聖後皆以為當與。

translations.literal: When Huizong ascended the throne, the relevant offices, because Dunli was on the noble register, submitted for review of grace gifts; the Emperor and Empress Qinsheng both held that he should receive them.
translations.idiomatic: When Huizong ascended the throne, the relevant offices, because Dunli was on the noble register, submitted for review of grace gifts. The Emperor and Empress Qinsheng both held that he should receive them.

sentences.zh: 惇等執前疏，欽聖曰：「戚裏何必預知朝廷事，當時罰亦太重矣。」

translations.literal: Dun and the others held to the earlier memorial; Qinsheng said: "Why must imperial kinsmen foreknow court affairs? The punishment at the time was also too heavy."
translations.idiomatic: Dun and the others held to the earlier memorial. Qinsheng said: "Why must imperial kinsmen foreknow court affairs? The punishment at the time was also too heavy."

sentences.zh: 復和州防禦使，進保信軍留後。

translations.literal: He was restored as Defender of He Prefecture and promoted to Acting Military Governor of Baoxin Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was restored as defender of He Prefecture and promoted to acting military governor of Baoxin Army.

sentences.zh: 崇寧初，拜寧遠軍節度使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongning he was appointed Military Governor of Ningyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Chongning he was appointed military governor of Ningyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 諫官王能甫言：「敦禮以匹夫之賤，一日而富貴具焉。

translations.literal: Remonstrance Official Wang Nengfu said: "Dunli, from the lowliness of a common man, in a single day possessed full wealth and rank.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance official Wang Nengfu said: "Dunli, from the lowliness of a common man, in a single day possessed full wealth and rank.

sentences.zh: 神宗親愛隆厚，禮遇優渥，而敦禮詆毀盛德，罪大謫輕。

translations.literal: Emperor Shenzong loved and favored him with deep kindness and treated him with exceptional courtesy, yet Dunli slandered his great virtue; the crime was great but the demotion was light.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shenzong loved and favored him with deep kindness and treated him with exceptional courtesy, yet Dunli slandered his great virtue. The crime was great but the demotion was light.

sentences.zh: 今復與之節鉞，無乃傷陛下『紹述』之志乎！」

translations.literal: Now to again grant him banner and credentials — would this not harm Your Majesty's resolve to 'continue the legacy'!"
translations.idiomatic: Now to again grant him banner and credentials — would this not harm Your Majesty's resolve to 'continue the legacy'?"

sentences.zh: 乃奪節，仍為集慶軍留後。

translations.literal: His credentials were thereupon stripped, and he remained Acting Military Governor of Jiqing Army.
translations.idiomatic: His credentials were thereupon stripped, and he remained acting military governor of Jiqing Army.

sentences.zh: 大觀初，復節度寧遠軍，徙雄武。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Daguang he again became Military Governor of Ningyuan Army and was transferred to Xiongwu.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Daguang he again became military governor of Ningyuan Army and was transferred to Xiongwu.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously granted Grand Master with the same ceremony as the Three Councillors.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously granted grand master with ceremonial standing equal to the Three Councillors.

sentences.zh: 任澤，字天錫，仙遊夫人母弟也。

translations.literal: Ren Ze, courtesy name Tianxi, was the younger brother of Lady Xianyou's mother.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Ze, courtesy name Tianxi, was the younger brother of Lady Xianyou's mother.

sentences.zh: 英宗入繼大統，召至延和殿，授西頭供奉官，賜第一區，寵賚甚厚。

translations.literal: When Yingzong succeeded to the great succession, he was summoned to Yanhe Hall, appointed Western Head Palace Attendant, granted one residence, and favored with generous gifts.
translations.idiomatic: When Yingzong succeeded to the throne, he was summoned to Yanhe Hall, appointed western head palace attendant, granted one residence, and favored with generous gifts.

sentences.zh: 神宗時，累遷皇城使，領昌州刺史。

translations.literal: During Shenzong's reign he was successively promoted to Commissioner of the Imperial City and served as Prefect of Chang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: During Shenzong's reign he was successively promoted to commissioner of the imperial city and served as prefect of Chang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 護仙遊柩遷祔於濮園， 真拜嘉州刺史。

translations.literal: He escorted Lady Xianyou's coffin for reburial at Pu Garden and was formally appointed Prefect of Jia Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He escorted Lady Xianyou's coffin for reburial at Pu Garden and was formally appointed prefect of Jia Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 卒，賜崇信軍節度使，諡曰恭僖，賜墓寺，寺額為「旌孝」。

translations.literal: He died and was granted Military Governor of Chongxin Army with the posthumous title Gongyi; a tomb temple was granted, its inscription reading "Commending Filial Piety."
translations.idiomatic: He died and was granted military governor of Chongxin Army with the posthumous title Gongyi. A tomb temple was granted, its inscription reading "Commending Filial Piety."

sentences.zh: 澤起田里，際會恩寵，能自安繩檢。

translations.literal: Ze rose from the fields; encountering favor and grace, he was able to keep himself within proper bounds.
translations.idiomatic: Ze rose from the fields. Encountering favor and grace, he was able to keep himself within proper bounds.

sentences.zh: 帝欲廣其居，固辭。

translations.literal: The Emperor wished to enlarge his residence; he firmly declined.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wished to enlarge his residence; he firmly declined.

sentences.zh: 當任子，弗請，其篤謹如此。

translations.literal: When it came time for the privilege of appointing a son to office, he did not request it — such was his sincere caution.
translations.idiomatic: When it came time for the privilege of appointing a son to office, he did not request it — such was his sincere caution.
